observations: Photo 0 shows a white console with a textured front panel, placed on a wooden surface next to a black wired controller with yellow, green, red, and blue buttons.
The console has a visible ventilation grille and a small logo on the top left corner, but the brand is not clearly readable.

Photo 1 shows the Xbox One S game library screen with 11 game icons visible: Assassin's Creed Black Flag, Batman: Arkham Knight, CTR, FIFA, Far Cry 3, Inside, Sifu, Titanfall 2, Tomb Raider: Legend, Watch Dogs 2, and a game with a 'Z' logo.
The screen displays '11 games' and 'Filter' button, confirming the count.
The controller is wired and appears to be a standard Xbox controller with analog sticks, D-pad, and action buttons.
The console is connected to a monitor via cables, and the monitor has a 'Search' button visible.
The photos are watermarked with 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'EMMA MART'.

claims.evidence: No photo shows this clearly enough to read.
Photo 1 shows 11 game icons in the game library screen, confirming the count.
Photo 0 shows a black wired controller with visible buttons and analog sticks, matching the description.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Console may be non-functional or have hardware issues (e.g., disc drive, power, cooling)
risks.proof: A video showing the console powering on, booting up, and playing a game from the library.

risks.risk: Games may be pirated or unauthorized, not included in the library
risks.proof: A screenshot of the Xbox settings showing the 'Owned' section with the same 11 games, or a video of the games being launched.

risks.risk: Controller may be non-functional or have damage
risks.proof: A video showing the controller connecting to the console and responding to button presses.

risks.risk: Console may have physical damage not visible in photos (e.g., scratches, dents, or internal damage)
risks.proof: A 360-degree video or close-up photos of the console's front, back, and sides.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and booting up, then playing a game from the library.
Video of the controller connecting and responding to button presses.
Close-up photos or video of the console's front, back, and sides to check for damage.
Screenshot or video of the Xbox settings showing the 'Owned' section with the 11 games.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
